title: Southwest Companion Pass Changes for 2027: What Cardholders Should Do Before December 2
why_now: Southwest announced on Oct 15, 2026 that from Jan 1, 2027 card welcome bonuses, anniversary points and bonus spend points stop counting toward the Companion Pass; cards approved by Dec 2, 2026 are grandfathered for the welcome bonus, and elevated 80K/85K/90K offers run through Dec 2. TPG, NerdWallet, Doctor of Credit and View from the Wing all covered it in the last 3 weeks.
angle: Plain answer first (what changes, the Dec 2 deadline), then which Southwest card to open now using the site's verified terms, and why a flexible card (Sapphire Preferred) may be the better long-term pick once card points stop counting.

facts.fact: Announced Oct 15, 2026; effective Jan 1, 2027: welcome bonuses, referral bonuses, anniversary points, bonus spend points and partner points stop counting toward the Companion Pass
Cardmembers approved on or before Dec 2, 2026 who meet the welcome-bonus requirement can still count those points, even if the spend is met in early 2027
New Platinum tier (140,000 TQP or 100 one-way flights) includes the unlimited Companion Pass; 95,000 TQP or 75 flights earns three Companion Pass trips; from 2027 Southwest cards earn 1 TQP per $1
Offers through Dec 2, 2026: Plus 80,000 after $1,000/3 mo ($99); Premier 85,000 after $2,000/3 mo; Priority 90,000 after $3,000/3 mo ($229)
A Companion Pass earned in 2026 is valid through Dec 31, 2027

title: IHG One Rewards Premier vs. Premier Select 2026: Is the New $350 Card Worth It?
why_now: Chase and IHG rebuilt the IHG card lineup on Oct 1, 2026: Premier fee rose to $150 with Gold status, a new $350 Premier Select launched, and limited-time offers (Premier 180K, Premier Select 200K) end Nov 18, 2026. NerdWallet, OMAAT, UpgradedPoints and InsideFlyer reviewed the new card this month.
angle: Head-to-head using the site's freshly corrected Premier terms; who should pay $200 more per year; deadline-driven.

facts.fact: Premier: $150 fee, 180,000 pts after $3,000/3 mo through Nov 18, 2026, Gold status, up to 24x at IHG, $100 F&B and $100 airline credits
Premier Select: $350 annual fee; 200,000-point limited-time offer (needs verification of spend and benefits before writing)

title: Chase Sapphire Preferred vs. Sapphire Reserve 2026: Which Sapphire Is Worth It After the Hyatt Change?
why_now: Since Oct 1, 2026 Hyatt transfers are 4:3 for all Sapphire Preferred cardmembers but stay 1:1 on the Reserve; the Preferred's anniversary bonus is gone and Points Boost tops out at 1.5¢ vs 2¢ on the Reserve. The site has no CSP vs CSR head-to-head, one of the highest-volume comparison searches.
angle: Break-even math on the $700 fee gap using the site's verified credits; Hyatt users get a concrete answer.

facts.fact: CSP Hyatt 4:3 for all cardmembers since Oct 1, 2026; Reserve keeps 1:1
Points Boost up to 1.5¢ (CSP) vs up to 2¢ (CSR)
CSP $95, 75,000 pts after $5,000/3 mo; CSR $795, 100,000 pts after $6,000/3 mo

title: Bilt 2027 Changes: How to Keep 4% Bilt Cash (and Whether You Should)
why_now: Bilt announced on Oct 27, 2026 that the 4% Bilt Cash option ends for accounts approved from 2027, with Bilt Cash moving to a rolling 12-month expiry; TPG, Doctor of Credit, Frequent Miler and Thrifty Traveler all covered it.
angle: Short decision guide tied to the site's Bilt review: the 4% option is an alternative to housing points, not additive.

facts.fact: 4% Bilt Cash is an alternative to tiered housing points; ends for accounts approved from 2027
Bilt Cash expires 12 months after it is earned (rolling) since Oct 27, 2026
